summary: Read-only verification of a deployment: migration head matches, health and process groups up, merged and deployed reported as separate facts, escape hatches past their date flagged.

required_inputs.name: target
required_inputs.description: Platform, app names and environment (staging or production)

required_inputs.name: expected_head
required_inputs.description: The migration head or commit the deployment should carry

required_inputs.name: checklist_doc
required_inputs.description: The repo's validation checklist, if one exists

checklist.rule: Only read commands and the platform CLI's status, logs and ssh-console reads; never deploy, scale, restart or run a migration
checklist.because: r3cruit3r main auto-deploys with no test gate; a verifier that can also deploy is a second deploy path

checklist.rule: The migration head on the running machine equals the expected head; both are pasted
checklist.because: LINDA's 39-character revision id applied its DDL then failed the version update; r3cruit3r has a documented history of branched heads

checklist.rule: Report merged and deployed as two facts with their own evidence; never infer one from the other
checklist.because: Flex main auto-deploys but a Vercel build can fail after merge; War Room AGENTS.md says a passing build does not establish that an integration works

checklist.rule: Every health URL answers and every process group or worker is running; each is listed with its result
checklist.because: r3cruit3r Celery queues map to fly.toml process groups; a missing group means tasks wait forever

checklist.rule: Temporary escape hatches past their date are flagged by name
checklist.because: r3cruit3r ALLOW_DEPLOY_WHEN_DB_UNREACHABLE widened the release gate; an unset expiry becomes permanent

checklist.rule: The last cron, beat or scheduled run is green, with its timestamp
checklist.because: Flex crons.yml opens a cron-failure issue only when the alert step itself works; the verifier reads the run, not the issue list

checklist.rule: No secret, token or DSN appears in the output; env listings are redacted
checklist.because: War Room AGENTS.md: never print credentials; audit reports must not contain found credentials

checklist.rule: The report separates checks executed from static review and names what could not be verified
checklist.because: War Room audit-report rules; a verifier that cannot reach a platform audits nothing and says so

done_output: migration head on machine versus expected
health URLs and process groups with results
stop_conditions: the platform CLI is not authenticated
the task asks to deploy, restart, scale or migrate

adapter_fields.name: apps
adapter_fields.description: App or project names per environment

adapter_fields.name: process_groups
adapter_fields.description: Worker or process groups that must be running

adapter_fields.name: migration_status_command
adapter_fields.description: How to read the applied head on the machine

adapter_fields.name: escape_hatches_to_flag
adapter_fields.description: Env vars or flags that widen a gate, with their intended expiry
